Foreword
Dear parents and carers,
Welcome to the primary school admissions prospectus for the London Borough of Croydon.
As an education authority we believe that every child should have the highest quality primary
education to achieve their full potential as this is their first phase of formal learning.
We are pleased that the quality of education in our primary schools continues to improve
with the percentage of pupils reaching the expected standard of attainment at the end of key
stage 2, which remains above the national average.
In this prospectus, you will find enclosed all the information you need to complete the
application for a school place for your child, including information about every primary,
infant and junior school in Croydon.
Our schools take pride in being inclusive, welcoming environments, where every child is
valued, supported, and encouraged to thrive. They actively partner with families and
communities to promote equality, embrace difference and ensure that every pupil feels seen.
We strongly encourage you to contact the schools and/or access the schools website that
you are considering applying to for a place for your child. We would recommend you use all
your six available preferences, listing them in order of preference, when you make your
application, as this maximises your opportunity to secure a school of preference for your
child.
Please note that you must still apply for a place, even if the school is linked to your child’s
current nursery, infant or primary school.
We wish your child a very successful start to their primary education.
